punchline: The same clothing allowance ended the fights with one sister and gave the other nothing but worry.
thirty_sec: A friend of Barry Schwartz gives his teenage daughter a lump-sum clothing allowance, and the fights stop. Same deal for her younger sister. The older one buys what she likes and moves on. The younger one agonizes over every item: is this the best use of my money, will I regret it in two months? Schwartz calls them a satisficer and a maximizer, and in his surveys the maximizers reported being less happy.
